# สมอง BC (BC Brain)

> Dual-audience knowledge base of the BC Ai Account product suite (Thai accounting/ERP for SMEs plus POS, AutoCare, e-Tax, WMS, TMS, Procure, CRM, LINE OA, Market, Dashboard, MonitorMap, WorkMonitor, Company Brain), verified against the real source code.

## Audience Zones (`audience` filter)
- `user`: Plain-Thai guides for end users, Call Center, and pre-sale assistants (`playbook`, `start`, `howto`, `troubleshoot`, `faq`, `reports`, `systems`, `glossary`, `sales`). No SQL/code jargon.
- `dev`: Technical specifications for developers and coding agents (`dev-playbook`, `schema`, `queries`, `api`, `doctypes`, `architecture`) — table schemas, PostgreSQL `SELECT`/`WITH` queries, `trans_flag` catalog, GL Dr/Cr rules, API/MCP contracts.
- `both`: Shared core map (`root` / `index.md`), included in both `"user"` and `"dev"` filters.
- `all`: Full knowledge base across every zone.

## For AI agents (MCP)
- MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP): https://brain.bcsmethai.com/mcp
- Public and read-only: no key or auth header needed.
- Tools (9 tools — speed-first, zero-overhead stateless JSON-RPC + LRU cache):
  - `quick_answer(question, audience?, max_chars?, include_media?)` — **FASTEST default** for real-time Q&A, Call Center, voice/LINE bots, and focused lookups: 1 single call (~2,000 chars, ~85% fewer tokens than `ask_brain`), strict `🛑 Abstain` guardrail, optional compact 1-line media
  - `lookup_menu(query, audience?, limit?)` — **instant O(1)** lookup for 4-digit menu codes (`1001`–`9070`), legacy dotted codes (`4.13`), Thai menu names, or SQL table names (`ic_trans`, `gl_journal`, etc. in `dev`/`all` mode)
  - `batch_read(slugs, audience?, query?, max_chars_per_note?, strip_links?)` — read 1–5 notes in ONE single call with optional query-focused section excerpting and strict audience isolation
  - `ask_brain(question, audience?, compact?, max_notes?)` — multi-note synthesis (`audience`: `"all" | "user" | "dev"`), ready-to-share `Media & Reference Links` (YouTube tutorials + `bcaccount.com` screenshots + website pages), and 1-hop Connected Graph Context
  - `search_brain(query, limit?, audience?)` — BM25 length-normalized Thai + 4-digit menu code + SQL identifier search (default `limit=5` for low latency) with `images` and `videos` media arrays
  - `find_media(query?, kind?, limit?, audience?)` — returns structured JSON of official screenshot URLs (`https://bcaccount.com/...`), YouTube video/playlist URLs (`PLO9P7tPZLXB0` with `thumbnailUrl` and `embedUrl`), and website pages
  - `traverse_brain(slug, to_slug?, depth?, direction?, relation?, folder?, limit?, audience?)` — follow 18 typed synapse relations (`uses_table`, `writes_table`, `posts_rule`, `has_query`, `exposes_api`, `solves_issue`, `shares_menu`, `implements_code`, `bridges_zone`, etc.) 1–3 hops or find shortest paths
  - `read_note(slug, query?, max_chars?)` — full or focused markdown note with `audience`, `youtube_videos`/`images`/`web_pages`, typed outgoing links, and backlinks
  - `list_notes(folder?, tag?, audience?)` — index of notes filterable by `folder`, `tag`, and `audience`
- **Call Center / Sales / Voice mode**: Call `quick_answer(..., audience: "user", include_media: true)` or `lookup_menu(..., audience: "user")` directly (no extra playbook round-trip needed; `playbook-call-center` / `playbook-sales` remain available when full scripts are needed). Cite both exact Thai menu breadcrumb paths AND 4-digit menu codes (`1001`–`9070` across 735 screens), include verified screenshot links (`https://bcaccount.com/...`) and YouTube tutorials (`PLO9P7tPZLXB0`), and answer in plain Thai without code/SQL jargon. Cite official pricing/support facts strictly from `sales-pricing-packages`, `sales-accounting-partner`, and `sales-support-implementation-contact` (prices exclude 7% VAT and external AI API costs; never invent custom discounts).
- **Developer mode**: Call `quick_answer(..., audience: "dev")`, `lookup_menu("<table_name>", audience: "dev")`, or `batch_read(..., audience: "dev")` directly (full map in `playbook-dev`). Follow `dev-rules-accounting-sql` (`NUMERIC`, `COALESCE(last_status, 0) = 0`).
- **Slash Skill (`/bcbrain`)**: Installable skill instructions at https://brain.bcsmethai.com/skills/bcbrain/SKILL.md (handles `/bcbrain`, `/bcbrain dev`, `/bcbrain all`, `/bcbrain setup`, and stateless HTTP JSON-RPC fallback).
